cohort: 8622 pregnant women at Lokmanya Tilak Medical College and Sion Hospital
finding: COVID-19 infection during pregnancy was not associated with significant differences in most maternal and fetal outcomes, although maternal mortality was higher in the COVID-positive group.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were higher in the COVID-positive group (49.45%) than in the COVID-negative group (43.95%), but this difference was not statistically significant (p >0.05).
birth_weight: majority between 2.6 and 3 kg in both groups
